glyph_origin: In the oracle bone script, it was originally 𠀠, a pictogram (象形) of a basket. In the bronze inscriptions, 丌 was added under the basket to represent a stand. It may also have acted as a phonetic component. Hence, the modified version was 𠔝. See also the bottom component of 眞. Later phonetically borrowed (假借) for an Old Chinese pronoun. The derivative 箕 refers to the original word.
senses: [jī] (obsolete) Used at the end of a sentence to show doubt.
